name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.kummerLogColumnFiniteLog_quotientMap_complexConj
statement:
theorem kummerLogColumnFiniteLog_quotientMap_complexConj
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (a : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) (N : ℕ) :
    Ideal.quotientMap ((lambdaIdeal p K) ^ (N + 1))
        (Conjugation.valuedIntegerComplexConj (p := p) K :
          ValuedIntegerRing p K →+* ValuedIntegerRing p K)
        (ideal_pow_le_comap_ringEquiv_of_map_eq (I := lambdaIdeal p K)
          (Conjugation.valuedIntegerComplexConj (p := p) K)
          (Conjugation.lambdaIdeal_map_valuedIntegerComplexConj
            (p := p) (K := K)) (N + 1))
        (kummerLogColumnFiniteLog (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a N) =
      kummerLogColumnFiniteLog (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a N
proof:
:= by
  rw [kummerLogColumnFiniteLog]
  rw [Conjugation.samePrimeFiniteLog_quotientMap_complexConj
    (p := p) (K := K)]
  exact samePrimeFiniteLog_eq_of_eq (p := p) (K := K)
    (N := N)
    (kummerLogColumnFiniteLogArg_complexConj (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a)
    (Conjugation.valuedIntegerComplexConj_mem_lambdaIdeal
      (p := p) (K := K)
      (kummerLogColumnFiniteLogArg_mem_lambdaIdeal
        (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a))

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.kummerLogCompletedColumn_complexConj
statement:
theorem kummerLogCompletedColumn_complexConj
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (a : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) :
    Conjugation.dworkCompleteComplexConj (p := p) K
        (kummerLogCompletedColumn (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a) =
      kummerLogCompletedColumn (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a
proof:
:= by
  apply AdicCompletion.ext_evalₐ
  intro N
  cases N with
  | zero =>
      trans 0
      · exact quotient_pow_zero_eq_zero (p := p) (K := K)
          (lambdaIdeal p K)
          (AdicCompletion.evalₐ (lambdaIdeal p K) 0
            (Conjugation.dworkCompleteComplexConj (p := p) K
              (kummerLogCompletedColumn (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a)))
      · exact (quotient_pow_zero_eq_zero (p := p) (K := K)
          (lambdaIdeal p K)
          (AdicCompletion.evalₐ (lambdaIdeal p K) 0
            (kummerLogCompletedColumn (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a))).symm
  | succ N =>
      rw [Conjugation.evalₐ_dworkCompleteComplexConj,
        kummerLogCompletedColumn_evalₐ_succ]
      exact kummerLogColumnFiniteLog_quotientMap_complexConj
        (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a N

name: KummerCriterion.cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_of_sinnottIndexFormula
statement:
theorem cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_of_sinnottIndexFormula
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p)
    (hSinnott : LehmerVandiver.Sinnott.SinnottIndexFormula p K hp_odd hp_three) :
    p ∣ (cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).index ↔

    p K hp_odd hp_three hSinnott
  change (cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).index =
      2 ^ ((p - 3) / 2) * hPlus K at hindex
  rw [hindex]

name: KummerCriterion.range_cyclotomicUnitFamilyKplusFinRank_eq

theorem range_cyclotomicUnitFamilyKplusFinRank_eq

name: KummerCriterion.torsionKplus_le_CPlus
statement:
theorem torsionKplus_le_CPlus (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    NumberField.Units.torsion K⁺ ≤ CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases maximalRealSubfield_torsion_eq_one_or_neg_one
      (K := K) ⟨x, hx⟩ with h_one | h_neg
  · have hx_one : x = 1 := by
      simpa using h_one
    rw [hx_one]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  · have hx_neg : x = -1 := by
      simpa using h_neg
    rw [hx_neg]
    exact neg_one_mem_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three

name: KummerCriterion.closure_cyclotomicUnitFamilyKplus_le_CPlus

          (LehmerVandiver.Sinnott.cyclotomicUnitFamilyKplusFinRank p K hp_odd hp_three)) ≤
      CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three

    (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three]
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact cyclotomicUnitFamilyKplus_mem_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three i

name: KummerCriterion.CPlus_le_cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup
statement:
theorem CPlus_le_cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three ≤
      cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three
proof:
:= by
  unfold CPlus cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup
  rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro x (hx | hx)
  · rcases hx with rfl
    exact Subgroup.mem_sup_right <| neg_one_mem_torsion
  · rcases hx with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [CPlusGenerator_eq_cyclotomicUnitFamilyKplus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three i]
    exact Subgroup.mem_sup_left <| Subgroup.subset_closure <|
      range_cyclotomicUnitFamilyKplusFinRank_eq (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three ▸
        Set.mem_range_self i

name: KummerCriterion.cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup_le_CPlus
statement:
theorem cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup_le_CPlus
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :

      CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three
proof:
:= by
  unfold cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup
  exact sup_le
    (closure_cyclotomicUnitFamilyKplus_le_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three)
    (torsionKplus_le_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three)

name: KummerCriterion.cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup_eq_CPlus
statement:
theorem cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup_eq_CPlus
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :

      CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup_le_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three)
    (CPlus_le_cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three)

name: KummerCriterion.cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_aux
statement:
theorem cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_aux
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (hp_two : 2 < p) (hp_ge_five : 5 ≤ p) :
    p ∣ (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).index ↔ p ∣ hPlus K
proof:
:= by
  have hdet :=
    kummerDirichletDeterminant_of_deletedFourier
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three hp_two hp_ge_five

      (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).symm.trans h_CPlus

name: KummerCriterion.hPlus_eq_one_of_eq_three
statement:
theorem hPlus_eq_one_of_eq_three (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_eq : p = 3) :
    hPlus K = 1
proof:
:= by
  subst p
  have : IsPrincipalIdealRing (𝓞 K) := IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.three_pid K
  have h_dvd : hPlus K ∣ h K :=
    hPlus_dvd_h (p := 3) (hp_odd := by norm_num) (K := K)
  have h_one : h K = 1 := by
    have h_class : NumberField.classNumber K = 1 :=
      NumberField.classNumber_eq_one_iff.mpr inferInstance
    simpa [h, NumberField.classNumber] using h_class
  rw [h_one] at h_dvd
  exact Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_one h_dvd

name: KummerCriterion.CPlus_eq_top_of_eq_three
statement:
theorem CPlus_eq_top_of_eq_three
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (hp_eq : p = 3) :
    CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h_rank : NumberField.Units.rank K⁺ = 0 := by
    have h_rank_eq :=
      (NumberField.IsCMField.units_rank_eq_units_rank (K := K)).trans
        (units_rank_eq_prime_sub_three_div_two (p := p) (K := K))
    simpa [hp_eq] using h_rank_eq
  apply le_antisymm le_top
  rw [← NumberField.Units.closure_fundSystem_sup_torsion_eq_top (K := K⁺)]
  refine sup_le ?_ (torsionKplus_le_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three)
  rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
  have hi : (i : ℕ) < 0 := by
    simpa [h_rank] using i.isLt
  omega

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCPlus_eq_top_of_eq_three
statement:
theorem normalizedCPlus_eq_top_of_eq_three
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (hp_eq : p = 3) :
    normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm le_top
  have hle := CPlus_le_normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three
  simpa [CPlus_eq_top_of_eq_three (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_eq] using hle

name: KummerCriterion.cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_of_eq_three
statement:
theorem cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_of_eq_three
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (hp_eq : p = 3) :
    p ∣ (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).index ↔ p ∣ hPlus K
proof:
:= by
  have h_index :
      (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).index = 1 := by
    rw [normalizedCPlus_eq_top_of_eq_three (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three hp_eq]
    exact Subgroup.index_top
  have h_hPlus : hPlus K = 1 :=
    hPlus_eq_one_of_eq_three (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_eq
  rw [h_index, h_hPlus]

name: KummerCriterion.cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_of_five_le
statement:
theorem cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_of_five_le (hp_ge_five : 5 ≤ p) :
    p ∣ (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K)
        (by omega : p ≠ 2) (by omega : 3 ≤ p)).index ↔
      p ∣ hPlus K
proof:
:=
  cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_aux
    (p := p) (K := K) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hp_ge_five

name: KummerCriterion.cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary
statement:
theorem cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) :
    p ∣ (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd
        (by have hp_two := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le; omega)).index ↔
      p ∣ hPlus K
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp_eq : p = 3
  · exact cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_of_eq_three
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd
      (by have hp_two := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le; omega) hp_eq
  · have hp_ge_five : 5 ≤ p := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).odd_of_ne_two hp_odd
      have hp_two := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le
      omega
    exact cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary_of_five_le
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_ge_five

name: KummerCriterion.subgroup_not_dvd_index_of_pSaturated_top_of_pow_eq_one_mem
statement:
theorem subgroup_not_dvd_index_of_pSaturated_top_of_pow_eq_one_mem
    {G : Type*} [CommGroup G] {H : Subgroup G} [H.FiniteIndex]
    (hsat : pSaturated H (⊤ : Subgroup G) p)
    (htorsion : ∀ g : G, g ^ p = 1 → g ∈ H) :
    ¬ p ∣ H.index
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hdiv
  have hcard : p ∣ Nat.card (G ⧸ H) := by
    simpa [Subgroup.index_eq_card] using hdiv
  obtain ⟨q, hq_order⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card' (G := G ⧸ H) p hcard
  have hq_pow : q ^ p = 1 := by
    rw [← hq_order]
    exact pow_orderOf_eq_one q
  revert hq_order hq_pow
  refine QuotientGroup.induction_on q ?_
  intro g hq_order hq_pow
  have hgpowH : g ^ p ∈ H :=
    (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := H) (g ^ p)).mp (by simpa using hq_pow)
  have hgpowTop : g ^ p ∈ pPowerSubgroup (⊤ : Subgroup G) p :=
    ⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top g, rfl⟩
  rcases pSaturated.mem_pPowerSubgroup_of_mem hsat hgpowH hgpowTop with
    ⟨h, hhH, hhp⟩
  have hgh_pow : (g * h⁻¹) ^ p = 1 := by
    simp [mul_pow, hhp]
  have hghH : g * h⁻¹ ∈ H := htorsion (g * h⁻¹) hgh_pow
  have hgH : g ∈ H := by
    simpa [mul_assoc] using H.mul_mem hghH hhH
  have hquot_one : ((g : G) : G ⧸ H) = 1 :=
    (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := H) g).mpr hgH
  have hp_one : p = 1 := by
    rw [← hq_order]
    simp [hquot_one]
  exact (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).ne_one hp_one

name: KummerCriterion.CPlus_index_ne_zero
statement:
theorem CPlus_index_ne_zero (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).index ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp_eq_three : p = 3
  · rw [CPlus_eq_top_of_eq_three (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_eq_three]
    simp
  · have hp_ne_four : p ≠ 4 := by
      intro hp_four
      have hprime_four : Nat.Prime 4 := hp_four ▸ (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p)
      norm_num at hprime_four
    have hp_five : 5 ≤ p := by omega
    have hp_odd : p ≠ 2 := by omega
    have hp_two : 2 < p := by omega
    have hdet :
        LehmerVandiver.Sinnott.KummerDirichletDeterminant p K hp_odd hp_three :=
      kummerDirichletDeterminant_of_deletedFourier
        (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three hp_two hp_five
    have hreg : LehmerVandiver.Sinnott.SinnottRegulatorIdentity p K hp_odd hp_three :=
      (LehmerVandiver.Sinnott.sinnottRegulatorIdentity_iff_kummerDirichletDeterminant
        (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).1 hdet
    have hsinnott : LehmerVandiver.Sinnott.SinnottIndexFormula p K hp_odd hp_three :=
      LehmerVandiver.Sinnott.sinnottIndexFormula_of_regulatorIdentity
        p K hp_odd hp_three hreg
    have hindex :=
      LehmerVandiver.Sinnott.index_eq_twoPow_mul_hPlus_of_sinnottIndexFormula
        p K hp_odd hp_three hsinnott
    change (cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).index =
      2 ^ ((p - 3) / 2) * hPlus K at hindex
    rw [cyclotomicUnitIndexSubgroup_eq_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three] at hindex
    rw [hindex]
    exact (Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos (by norm_num : 0 < 2) _)
      (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero Fintype.card_ne_zero)).ne'

name: KummerCriterion.not_dvd_index_of_pSaturated
statement:
theorem not_dvd_index_of_pSaturated (hp_three : 3 ≤ p)
    (hsat : pSaturated (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three) (EPlus (K := K)) p) :
    ¬ p ∣ (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).index
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let H : Subgroup (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ := CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three
  have : H.FiniteIndex := ⟨by
    simpa [H] using CPlus_index_ne_zero (p := p) (K := K) hp_three⟩
  have hsatTop : pSaturated H (⊤ : Subgroup (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ) p := by
    simpa [H, EPlus] using hsat
  have htorsion : ∀ g : (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ, g ^ p = 1 → g ∈ H := by
    intro g hg
    have hg_torsion : g ∈ NumberField.Units.torsion K⁺ := by
      change g ∈ CommGroup.torsion (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ
      exact (CommGroup.mem_torsion g).mpr
        (isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.mpr ⟨p, (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).pos, hg⟩)
    simpa [H] using
      torsionKplus_le_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hg_torsion
  exact subgroup_not_dvd_index_of_pSaturated_top_of_pow_eq_one_mem
    (p := p) (H := H) hsatTop htorsion

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.concreteKummerLogMatrix_eq_diagonal_mul_vandermonde
statement:
theorem concreteKummerLogMatrix_eq_diagonal_mul_vandermonde
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (hp_five : 5 ≤ p) :
    concreteKummerLogMatrix (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five =
      Matrix.diagonal (kummerLogDetRowFactor (p := p)) *
        vandermondeTeichmullerEvenSubOneMatrix (p := p) hp_three
proof:
:= by
  ext j a
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  rw [kummerLogCoeff_congr (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five j a]
  simp only [kummerLogDetRowFactor, vandermondeTeichmullerEvenSubOneMatrix,
    teichmullerEvenNode, kummerLogRowIndex, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have hpow :
      ((((a : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 2) ^ 2) ^ ((j : ℕ) + 1) =
        (((a : ℕ) : ZMod p) + 2) ^ (2 * ((j : ℕ) + 1)) := by
    rw [pow_mul]
  rw [hpow]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.concreteKummerLogMatrix_det_eq_prod_rowFactor_mul_vandermonde_det
statement:
theorem concreteKummerLogMatrix_det_eq_prod_rowFactor_mul_vandermonde_det
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (hp_five : 5 ≤ p) :
    (concreteKummerLogMatrix (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five).det =
      (∏ j : Fin (kummerLogRank p), kummerLogDetRowFactor (p := p) j) *
        (vandermondeTeichmullerEvenSubOneMatrix (p := p) hp_three).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [concreteKummerLogMatrix_eq_diagonal_mul_vandermonde
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five,
    Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.concreteKummerLogMatrix_det_ne_zero_iff_forall_rowFactor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem concreteKummerLogMatrix_det_ne_zero_iff_forall_rowFactor_ne_zero
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (hp_five : 5 ≤ p) :
    (concreteKummerLogMatrix (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five).det ≠ 0 ↔
      ∀ j : Fin (kummerLogRank p), kummerLogDetRowFactor (p := p) j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [concreteKummerLogMatrix_det_eq_prod_rowFactor_mul_vandermonde_det
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five]
  constructor
  · intro h j hrow
    have hprod :
        (∏ j : Fin (kummerLogRank p), kummerLogDetRowFactor (p := p) j) = 0 :=
      Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hrow⟩
    exact h (by rw [hprod, zero_mul])
  · intro h
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (by intro j _; exact h j))
      (vandermonde_teichmuller_even_sub_one_det_ne_zero (p := p) hp_three)

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.kummerLogDetRowFactor_ne_zero_iff_bernoulliFactor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem kummerLogDetRowFactor_ne_zero_iff_bernoulliFactor_ne_zero
    (hp_five : 5 ≤ p) (j : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) :
    kummerLogDetRowFactor (p := p) j ≠ 0 ↔
      bernoulliFactor p (kummerLogRowIndex (p := p) j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold kummerLogDetRowFactor
  constructor
  · intro h hB
    exact h (mul_eq_zero.mpr (Or.inr hB))
  · intro hB
    exact mul_ne_zero
      (squaredKummerLogUnitFactor_ne_zero (p := p) hp_five j) hB

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.concreteKummerLogMatrix_det_ne_zero_iff_forall_bernoulliFactor_ne_zero
statement:
theorem concreteKummerLogMatrix_det_ne_zero_iff_forall_bernoulliFactor_ne_zero
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (hp_five : 5 ≤ p) :
    (concreteKummerLogMatrix (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five).det ≠ 0 ↔
      ∀ j : Fin (kummerLogRank p),
        bernoulliFactor p (kummerLogRowIndex (p := p) j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [concreteKummerLogMatrix_det_ne_zero_iff_forall_rowFactor_ne_zero
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five]
  constructor
  · intro h j
    exact (kummerLogDetRowFactor_ne_zero_iff_bernoulliFactor_ne_zero
      (p := p) hp_five j).mp (h j)
  · intro h j
    exact (kummerLogDetRowFactor_ne_zero_iff_bernoulliFactor_ne_zero
      (p := p) hp_five j).mpr (h j)

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.bernoulliFactor_ne_zero_iff_not_dvd_bernoulli_num
statement:
theorem bernoulliFactor_ne_zero_iff_not_dvd_bernoulli_num
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjp : 2 * j ≤ p - 3) :
    bernoulliFactor p j ≠ 0 ↔
      ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (_root_.bernoulli (2 * j)).num
proof:
:= by
  let B : ℚ := _root_.bernoulli (2 * j)
  let n : ℕ := 2 * j
  let q : ℚ := B / (n : ℚ)
  let D : ℕ := B.den * n
  have hn_pos : 0 < n := by
    dsimp [n]
    omega
  have hnQ_ne : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hn_pos.ne'
  have hD_pos : 0 < D := by
    dsimp [D]
    exact Nat.mul_pos B.den_pos hn_pos
  have hD_int_ne : ((D : ℕ) : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hD_pos.ne'
  have hqdf : q = Rat.divInt B.num ((D : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    calc
      q = B / (n : ℚ) := rfl
      _ = ((B.num : ℚ) / (B.den : ℚ)) / (n : ℚ) := by
        rw [Rat.num_div_den]
      _ = (B.num : ℚ) / (D : ℚ) := by
        dsimp [D]
        field_simp [hnQ_ne]
        rw [Nat.cast_mul]
        ring
      _ = Rat.divInt B.num ((D : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
        rw [Rat.divInt_eq_div]
        norm_num
  obtain ⟨c, hcnum, hcden⟩ := Rat.num_den_mk hD_int_ne hqdf
  have hD_zmod_ne : ((D : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    have hBden := bernoulli_den_zmod_ne_zero (p := p) (j := j) hj hjp
    have hn := two_mul_index_zmod_ne_zero (p := p) (j := j) hj hjp
    simpa [D, B, n, Nat.cast_mul] using mul_ne_zero hBden hn
  have hcden_zmod :
      ((D : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (c : ZMod p) * (q.den : ZMod p) := by
    have hcast := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : ZMod p)) hcden
    simpa [Int.cast_mul] using hcast
  have hc_zmod_ne : (c : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := fun hc_zero =>
    hD_zmod_ne (by rw [hcden_zmod, hc_zero, zero_mul])
  have hqden_zmod_ne : ((q.den : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := fun hqden_zero =>
    hD_zmod_ne (by rw [hcden_zmod, hqden_zero, mul_zero])
  have hcnum_zmod :
      ((B.num : ℤ) : ZMod p) = (c : ZMod p) * (q.num : ZMod p) := by
    have hcast := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : ZMod p)) hcnum
    simpa [Int.cast_mul] using hcast
  have hqnum_ne_iff_Bnum_ne :
      (q.num : ZMod p) ≠ 0 ↔ ((B.num : ℤ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro hq hB
      have hmul : (c : ZMod p) * (q.num : ZMod p) = 0 := by
        simpa [hcnum_zmod] using hB
      exact hq ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hc_zmod_ne)
    · intro hB hq
      exact hB (by rw [hcnum_zmod, hq, mul_zero])
  have hred_ne_iff : ratReductionZMod p q ≠ 0 ↔ (q.num : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    unfold ratReductionZMod
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    constructor
    · intro h hq
      exact h (by rw [hq, zero_mul])
    · intro hq hzero
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hzero with hnum | hden_inv
      · exact hq hnum
      · exact (inv_ne_zero hqden_zmod_ne) hden_inv
  have hBnum_ne_iff :
      (((_root_.bernoulli (2 * j)).num : ℤ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 ↔
        ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (_root_.bernoulli (2 * j)).num :=
    not_congr (CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod p) p
      ((_root_.bernoulli (2 * j)).num))
  simpa [bernoulliFactor, q, B, n] using
    hred_ne_iff.trans (hqnum_ne_iff_Bnum_ne.trans (by simpa [B] using hBnum_ne_iff))

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.exists_fin_kummerLogRowIndex_eq_of_mem_range
statement:
theorem exists_fin_kummerLogRowIndex_eq_of_mem_range
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hjp : 2 * j ≤ p - 3) :
    ∃ i : Fin (kummerLogRank p), kummerLogRowIndex (p := p) i = j
proof:
:= by
  have hj_le_rank : j ≤ kummerLogRank p := by
    rw [kummerLogRank]
    exact (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le Nat.zero_lt_two).mpr (by omega)
  refine ⟨⟨j - 1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
  simp [kummerLogRowIndex]
  omega

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.kummerLogMatrix_det_ne_zero_iff_bernoulli_nonzero
statement:
theorem kummerLogMatrix_det_ne_zero_iff_bernoulli_nonzero
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (hp_five : 5 ≤ p) :
    (concreteKummerLogMatrix (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five).det ≠ 0 ↔
      ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → 2 * j ≤ p - 3 →
        ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (_root_.bernoulli (2 * j)).num
proof:
:= by
  rw [concreteKummerLogMatrix_det_ne_zero_iff_forall_bernoulliFactor_ne_zero
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five]
  constructor
  · intro h j hj hjp
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ :=
      exists_fin_kummerLogRowIndex_eq_of_mem_range (p := p) hj hjp
    exact (bernoulliFactor_ne_zero_iff_not_dvd_bernoulli_num
      (p := p) (j := j) hj hjp).mp (by simpa [hi] using h i)
  · intro h i
    exact (bernoulliFactor_ne_zero_iff_not_dvd_bernoulli_num
      (p := p)
      (j := kummerLogRowIndex (p := p) i)
      (kummerLogRowIndex_one_le (p := p) i)
      (two_mul_kummerLogRowIndex_le_sub_three (p := p) i)).mpr
        (h (kummerLogRowIndex (p := p) i)
          (kummerLogRowIndex_one_le (p := p) i)
          (two_mul_kummerLogRowIndex_le_sub_three (p := p) i))

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.sum_subtype_ne_eq_sum_erase
statement:
theorem sum_subtype_ne_eq_sum_erase {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (a₀ : α) (f : α → ℂ) [Fintype {x : α // x ≠ a₀}] :
    ∑ x : {x : α // x ≠ a₀}, f x.val =
      ∑ x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α).erase a₀, f x
proof:
:=
  (Finset.sum_subtype _ (fun x => by simp) f).symm

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.card_nonidentity_add_one
statement:
theorem card_nonidentity_add_one [DecidableEq G] :
    Fintype.card (Nonidentity G) + 1 = Fintype.card G
proof:
:= by
  have hnon :
      Fintype.card (Nonidentity G) = Fintype.card G - 1 := by
    simp [Nonidentity]
  rw [hnon]
  exact Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨(1 : G)⟩))

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.card_group_ne_zero_complex
statement:
theorem card_group_ne_zero_complex :
    ((Fintype.card G : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨(1 : G)⟩).ne'

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.sum_nonidentity_mulChar_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem sum_nonidentity_mulChar_eq_neg_one
    [DecidableEq G]
    (χ : MulChar G ℂ) (hχ : χ ≠ 1) :
    ∑ h : Nonidentity G, χ h.val = -1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfull : ∑ g : G, χ g = 0 := MulChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one hχ
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (1 : G))] at hfull
  rw [← sum_subtype_ne_eq_sum_erase (α := G) (a₀ := 1) (f := fun g => χ g)] at hfull
  have hsplit : (1 : ℂ) + ∑ h : Nonidentity G, χ h.val = 0 := by
    simpa using hfull
  linear_combination hsplit

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.sum_nonidentity_inv_mulChar_mul
statement:
theorem sum_nonidentity_inv_mulChar_mul
    [DecidableEq G]
    [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]
    (χ ψ : MulChar G ℂ) :
    ∑ h : Nonidentity G, (χ h.val)⁻¹ * ψ h.val =
      if χ = ψ then (Fintype.card (Nonidentity G) : ℂ) else -1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hχψ : χ = ψ
  · subst hχψ
    rw [ite_eq_left rfl]
    rw [show (∑ h : Nonidentity G, (χ h.val)⁻¹ * χ h.val) =
        ∑ _h : Nonidentity G, (1 : ℂ) from by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro h _
      have h_unit : IsUnit (χ h.val) := IsUnit.map χ.toMonoidHom (Group.isUnit h.val)
      exact inv_mul_cancel₀ h_unit.ne_zero]
    simp
  · rw [ite_eq_right hχψ]
    have hchar : χ⁻¹ * ψ ≠ 1 := by rwa [Ne, inv_mul_eq_one]
    rw [← sum_nonidentity_mulChar_eq_neg_one (G := G) (χ⁻¹ * ψ) hchar]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro h _
    rw [MulChar.mul_apply, MulChar.inv_apply_eq_inv']

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.deletedCharacterMatrix_leftInverse
statement:
theorem deletedCharacterMatrix_leftInverse
    [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]
    (ρ : NontrivChar G ≃ Nonidentity G) :
    deletedCharacterMatrixLeftInverse (G := G) ρ *
        deletedCharacterMatrix (G := G) ρ = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext χ ψ
  simp only [deletedCharacterMatrixLeftInverse, deletedCharacterMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [Equiv.sum_comp ρ (fun h : Nonidentity G =>
    (((Fintype.card G : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * ((χ.val h.val)⁻¹ - 1)) * ψ.val h.val)]
  rw [show (∑ h : Nonidentity G,
      ((Fintype.card G : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ * ((χ.val h.val)⁻¹ - 1) * ψ.val h.val) =
      ∑ h : Nonidentity G,
        ((Fintype.card G : ℕ) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
          (((χ.val h.val)⁻¹ - 1) * ψ.val h.val) from by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro h _
    ring]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hsplit :
      (∑ h : Nonidentity G, ((χ.val h.val)⁻¹ - 1) * ψ.val h.val) =
        (∑ h : Nonidentity G, (χ.val h.val)⁻¹ * ψ.val h.val) -
          ∑ h : Nonidentity G, ψ.val h.val := by
    simp_rw [sub_mul, one_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hsplit]
  rw [sum_nonidentity_inv_mulChar_mul (G := G) χ.val ψ.val]
  rw [sum_nonidentity_mulChar_eq_neg_one (G := G) ψ.val ψ.property]
  by_cases hχψ : χ = ψ
  · subst hχψ
    simp only [ite_true]
    have hcard : ((Fintype.card (Nonidentity G) : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 =
        ((Fintype.card G : ℕ) : ℂ) := by
      exact_mod_cast card_nonidentity_add_one (G := G)
    have hnz : ((Fintype.card G : ℕ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
      card_group_ne_zero_complex (G := G)
    rw [sub_neg_eq_add, hcard, inv_mul_cancel₀ hnz]
  · have hval : χ.val ≠ ψ.val := fun h =>
      hχψ (Subtype.ext h)
    simp [hval, hχψ]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.sum_translate_inv_mulChar
statement:
theorem sum_translate_inv_mulChar
    (q : G → ℂ) (χ : MulChar G ℂ) (h : G) :
    ∑ k : G, q (h * k⁻¹) * χ k =
      χ h * deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : G ≃ G := (Equiv.inv G).trans (Equiv.mulLeft h)
  have he_apply : ∀ k : G, e k = h * k⁻¹ := by
    intro k
    rfl
  have hsum := Equiv.sum_comp e (fun t : G => q t * χ (t⁻¹ * h))
  have hleft :
      (∑ k : G, q (e k) * χ ((e k)⁻¹ * h)) =
        ∑ k : G, q (h * k⁻¹) * χ k := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro k _
    rw [he_apply]
    have hk : (h * k⁻¹)⁻¹ * h = k := by group
    rw [hk]
  rw [hleft] at hsum
  rw [hsum]
  unfold deletedFourierCoeff
  have hterm : ∀ t : G, q t * χ (t⁻¹ * h) =
      χ h * (q t * (χ t)⁻¹) := by
    intro t
    rw [map_mul, map_inv]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => hterm t)]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.sum_nonidentity_translate_inv_mulChar
statement:
theorem sum_nonidentity_translate_inv_mulChar
    [DecidableEq G]
    (q : G → ℂ) (χ : MulChar G ℂ) (h : G) :
    ∑ k : Nonidentity G, q (h * k.val⁻¹) * χ k.val =
      χ h * deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ - q h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfull := sum_translate_inv_mulChar (G := G) q χ h
  rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (1 : G))] at hfull
  rw [← sum_subtype_ne_eq_sum_erase (α := G) (a₀ := 1)
    (f := fun k : G => q (h * k⁻¹) * χ k)] at hfull
  have hsplit :
      q h + ∑ k : Nonidentity G, q (h * k.val⁻¹) * χ k.val =
        χ h * deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ := by
    simpa using hfull
  linear_combination hsplit

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.sum_nonidentity_deletedConvolution_mulChar
statement:
theorem sum_nonidentity_deletedConvolution_mulChar
    [DecidableEq G]
    (q : G → ℂ) (χ : MulChar G ℂ) (hχ : χ ≠ 1) (h : G) :
    ∑ k : Nonidentity G, (q (h * k.val⁻¹) - q h) * χ k.val =
      χ h * deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfirst := sum_nonidentity_translate_inv_mulChar (G := G) q χ h
  have hchar := sum_nonidentity_mulChar_eq_neg_one (G := G) χ hχ
  have hsplit :
      (∑ k : Nonidentity G, (q (h * k.val⁻¹) - q h) * χ k.val) =
        (∑ k : Nonidentity G, q (h * k.val⁻¹) * χ k.val) -
          q h * ∑ k : Nonidentity G, χ k.val := by
    simp_rw [sub_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hsplit, hfirst, hchar]
  ring

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.deletedConvolutionMatrix_eq_submatrix
statement:
theorem deletedConvolutionMatrix_eq_submatrix
    (ρ : NontrivChar G ≃ Nonidentity G) (q : G → ℂ) :
    deletedConvolutionMatrix (G := G) ρ q =
      (deletedConvolutionMatrixOnNonidentity (G := G) q).submatrix ρ ρ
proof:
:= by
  ext h k
  rfl

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.deletedConvolution_mul_deletedCharacter
statement:
theorem deletedConvolution_mul_deletedCharacter
    [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]
    (ρ : NontrivChar G ≃ Nonidentity G) (q : G → ℂ) :
    deletedConvolutionMatrix (G := G) ρ q *
        deletedCharacterMatrix (G := G) ρ =
      deletedCharacterMatrix (G := G) ρ *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun χ : NontrivChar G =>
          deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ.val)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext h χ
  simp only [deletedConvolutionMatrix, deletedCharacterMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  rw [Equiv.sum_comp ρ (fun k : Nonidentity G =>
    (q ((ρ h).val * k.val⁻¹) - q (ρ h).val) * χ.val k.val)]
  rw [sum_nonidentity_deletedConvolution_mulChar
    (G := G) q χ.val χ.property (ρ h).val]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single χ]
  · simp
  · intro ψ _ hψ
    rw [ite_eq_right hψ, mul_zero]
  · intro hmem
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ χ) hmem

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.det_deletedConvolutionMatrix_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeff
statement:
theorem det_deletedConvolutionMatrix_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeff
    [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]
    (ρ : NontrivChar G ≃ Nonidentity G) (q : G → ℂ) :
    (deletedConvolutionMatrix (G := G) ρ q).det =
      ∏ χ : NontrivChar G, deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ.val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmul := deletedConvolution_mul_deletedCharacter (G := G) ρ q
  have hdet := congrArg Matrix.det hmul
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal] at hdet
  have hP : (deletedCharacterMatrix (G := G) ρ).det ≠ 0 :=
    Matrix.det_ne_zero_of_left_inverse
      (deletedCharacterMatrix_leftInverse (G := G) ρ)
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ hP (by
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hdet)

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.det_deletedConvolutionMatrixOnNonidentity_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeff
statement:
theorem det_deletedConvolutionMatrixOnNonidentity_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeff
    [DecidableEq G] [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]
    (ρ : NontrivChar G ≃ Nonidentity G) (q : G → ℂ) :
    (deletedConvolutionMatrixOnNonidentity (G := G) q).det =
      ∏ χ : NontrivChar G, deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) q χ.val
proof:
:= by
  have h := det_deletedConvolutionMatrix_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeff
    (G := G) ρ q
  rw [deletedConvolutionMatrix_eq_submatrix] at h
  rwa [Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self] at h

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed_eq_translated
statement:
theorem deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed_eq_translated
    (h₀ : G) (q : G → ℂ) :
    deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed (G := G) h₀ q =
      deletedConvolutionMulMatrixOnNonidentity (G := G) (fun h => q (h₀ * h))
proof:
:= by
  ext h k
  simp [deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed, deletedConvolutionMulMatrixOnNonidentity,
    mul_assoc]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.deletedConvolutionMulMatrix_eq_invRow_submatrix
statement:
theorem deletedConvolutionMulMatrix_eq_invRow_submatrix (q : G → ℂ) :
    deletedConvolutionMulMatrixOnNonidentity (G := G) q =
      (deletedConvolutionMatrixOnNonidentity (G := G) (fun x => q x⁻¹)).submatrix
        (nonidentityInvEquiv (G := G)) id
proof:
:= by
  ext h k
  simp [deletedConvolutionMulMatrixOnNonidentity, deletedConvolutionMatrixOnNonidentity,
    nonidentityInvEquiv, mul_comm]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.prod_mulChar_apply_sq_eq_one
statement:
theorem prod_mulChar_apply_sq_eq_one
    [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] (h₀ : G) :
    (∏ χ : MulChar G ℂ, χ h₀) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P : ℂ := ∏ χ : MulChar G ℂ, χ h₀
  have hP_inv : P = P⁻¹ := by
    calc
      P = ∏ χ : MulChar G ℂ, χ h₀ := rfl
      _ = ∏ χ : MulChar G ℂ, (χ⁻¹) h₀ := by
        rw [← Equiv.prod_comp (Equiv.inv (MulChar G ℂ)) (fun χ => χ h₀)]
        rfl
      _ = ∏ χ : MulChar G ℂ, (χ h₀)⁻¹ := by
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_
        intro χ _
        rw [MulChar.inv_apply_eq_inv']
      _ = P⁻¹ := by
        rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
  have hP_ne : P ≠ 0 := by
    refine Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr ?_
    intro χ _
    exact (IsUnit.map χ.toMonoidHom (Group.isUnit h₀)).ne_zero
  calc
    P ^ 2 = P * P := pow_two P
    _ = P * P⁻¹ := congrArg (fun z => P * z) hP_inv
    _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hP_ne

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.prod_nontriv_mulChar_apply_sq_eq_one
statement:
theorem prod_nontriv_mulChar_apply_sq_eq_one
    [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)] (h₀ : G) :
    (∏ χ : NontrivChar G, χ.val h₀) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have herase :
      (∏ χ : NontrivChar G, χ.val h₀) =
        ∏ χ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (MulChar G ℂ)).erase 1, χ h₀ := by
    rw [Finset.prod_subtype
      (p := fun χ : MulChar G ℂ => χ ≠ 1)
      (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (MulChar G ℂ)).erase 1)
      (f := fun χ => χ h₀)]
    intro χ
    simp [Finset.mem_erase]
  rw [herase]
  have hfull := prod_mulChar_apply_sq_eq_one (G := G) h₀
  have htriv : (1 : MulChar G ℂ) h₀ = 1 :=
    MulChar.one_apply (Group.isUnit h₀)
  have herase_full :
      (∏ χ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (MulChar G ℂ)).erase 1, χ h₀) =
        ∏ χ : MulChar G ℂ, χ h₀ :=
    Finset.prod_erase (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (MulChar G ℂ)))
      (f := fun χ => χ h₀) (a := 1) htriv
  rw [herase_full]
  exact hfull

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.prod_nontriv_mulChar_apply_inv_sq_eq_one
statement:
theorem prod_nontriv_mulChar_apply_inv_sq_eq_one
    [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)] (h₀ : G) :
    (∏ χ : NontrivChar G, (χ.val h₀)⁻¹) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show (∏ χ : NontrivChar G, (χ.val h₀)⁻¹) =
      (∏ χ : NontrivChar G, χ.val h₀)⁻¹ from by
    rw [Finset.prod_inv_distrib]]
  rw [inv_pow, prod_nontriv_mulChar_apply_sq_eq_one (G := G) h₀, inv_one]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.deletedFourierCoeffMul_mulLeft
statement:
theorem deletedFourierCoeffMul_mulLeft
    (q : G → ℂ) (χ : MulChar G ℂ) (h₀ : G) :
    deletedFourierCoeffMul (G := G) (fun h => q (h₀ * h)) χ =
      (χ h₀)⁻¹ * deletedFourierCoeffMul (G := G) q χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold deletedFourierCoeffMul
  have hsum := Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.mulLeft h₀)
    (fun h : G => χ (h₀⁻¹ * h) * q h)
  have hleft :
      (∑ x : G, χ (h₀⁻¹ * (Equiv.mulLeft h₀) x) *
          q ((Equiv.mulLeft h₀) x)) =
        ∑ x : G, χ x * q (h₀ * x) := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro x _
    simp
  rw [hleft] at hsum
  rw [hsum]
  have hterm : ∀ h : G, χ (h₀⁻¹ * h) * q h =
      (χ h₀)⁻¹ * (χ h * q h) := by
    intro h
    rw [map_mul, map_inv]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun h _ => hterm h)]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.deletedFourierCoeff_invArg_eq_mul
statement:
theorem deletedFourierCoeff_invArg_eq_mul
    (q : G → ℂ) (χ : MulChar G ℂ) :
    deletedFourierCoeff (G := G) (fun x => q x⁻¹) χ =
      deletedFourierCoeffMul (G := G) q χ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold deletedFourierCoeff deletedFourierCoeffMul
  have hsum := Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.inv G)
    (fun h : G => q h * (χ h⁻¹)⁻¹)
  have hleft :
      (∑ x : G, q ((Equiv.inv G) x) * (χ ((Equiv.inv G) x)⁻¹)⁻¹) =
        ∑ x : G, q x⁻¹ * (χ x)⁻¹ := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro x _
    simp
  rw [hleft] at hsum
  rw [hsum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro h _
  rw [map_inv]
  rw [inv_inv]
  rw [mul_comm]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.det_deletedConvolutionMulMatrixOnNonidentity_sq_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeffMul_sq
statement:
theorem det_deletedConvolutionMulMatrixOnNonidentity_sq_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeffMul_sq
    [DecidableEq G] [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]
    (ρ : NontrivChar G ≃ Nonidentity G) (q : G → ℂ) :
    (deletedConvolutionMulMatrixOnNonidentity (G := G) q).det ^ 2 =
      (∏ χ : NontrivChar G, deletedFourierCoeffMul (G := G) q χ.val) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [deletedConvolutionMulMatrix_eq_invRow_submatrix]
  rw [Matrix.det_permute]
  rw [mul_pow]
  rw [show ((↑↑(Equiv.Perm.sign (nonidentityInvEquiv (G := G))) : ℂ)) ^ 2 = 1 from ?_]
  · rw [one_mul]
    rw [det_deletedConvolutionMatrixOnNonidentity_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeff
      (G := G) ρ (fun x => q x⁻¹)]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_
    intro χ _
    exact deletedFourierCoeff_invArg_eq_mul (G := G) q χ.val
  · have h_sign : (Equiv.Perm.sign (nonidentityInvEquiv (G := G))) ^ 2 = 1 :=
      Int.units_pow_two _
    have h_cast : (((Equiv.Perm.sign (nonidentityInvEquiv (G := G))) ^ 2 : ℤˣ) : ℂ) =
        ((1 : ℤˣ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [h_sign]
    push_cast at h_cast ⊢
    exact_mod_cast h_cast

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.det_deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed_sq_eq_charFactor_mul_prod_sq
statement:
theorem det_deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed_sq_eq_charFactor_mul_prod_sq
    [DecidableEq G] [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]
    (ρ : NontrivChar G ≃ Nonidentity G) (h₀ : G) (q : G → ℂ) :
    (deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed (G := G) h₀ q).det ^ 2 =
      ((∏ χ : NontrivChar G, (χ.val h₀)⁻¹) *
        ∏ χ : NontrivChar G, deletedFourierCoeffMul (G := G) q χ.val) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed_eq_translated]
  rw [det_deletedConvolutionMulMatrixOnNonidentity_sq_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeffMul_sq
    (G := G) ρ (fun h => q (h₀ * h))]
  congr 1
  simp_rw [deletedFourierCoeffMul_mulLeft (G := G) q]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.det_deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed_sq_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeffMul_sq
statement:
theorem det_deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed_sq_eq_prod_deletedFourierCoeffMul_sq
    [DecidableEq G] [Fintype (MulChar G ℂ)] [DecidableEq (MulChar G ℂ)]
    (ρ : NontrivChar G ≃ Nonidentity G) (h₀ : G) (q : G → ℂ) :
    (deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed (G := G) h₀ q).det ^ 2 =
      (∏ χ : NontrivChar G, deletedFourierCoeffMul (G := G) q χ.val) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [det_deletedConvolutionMulMatrixAtReindexed_sq_eq_charFactor_mul_prod_sq
    (G := G) ρ h₀ q]
  rw [mul_pow, prod_nontriv_mulChar_apply_inv_sq_eq_one (G := G) h₀, one_mul]

name: KummerCriterion.dvd_h_iff_dvd_hMinus_of_dvd_hPlus_imp
statement:
theorem dvd_h_iff_dvd_hMinus_of_dvd_hPlus_imp
    {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hp_odd : p ≠ 2)
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} ℚ K]
    [IsCMField K]
    (hplus_to_hminus : (p : ℕ) ∣ hPlus K → (p : ℕ) ∣ hMinus K) :
    (p : ℕ) ∣ h K ↔ (p : ℕ) ∣ hMinus K
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hpH
    rw [h_eq_hPlus_mul_hMinus p hp_odd K] at hpH
    rcases hp.out.dvd_mul.mp hpH with hplus | hminus
    · exact hplus_to_hminus hplus
    · exact hminus
  · intro hminus
    rw [h_eq_hPlus_mul_hMinus p hp_odd K]
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hminus (hPlus K)

name: KummerCriterion.bernoulli_nonzero_of_not_dvd_hMinus
statement:
theorem bernoulli_nonzero_of_not_dvd_hMinus
    {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p} ℚ K]
    [IsCMField K] (hp_odd : p ≠ 2)
    (hminus : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ hMinus K) :
    ∀ k, 1 ≤ k → 2 * k ≤ p - 3 →
      ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (bernoulli (2 * k)).num
proof:
:= fun k hk hk_range hnum =>
  hminus <|
    (p_dvd_hMinus_iff_p_dvd_some_bernoulli (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd).2
      ⟨k, hk, hk_range, hnum⟩

name: KummerCriterion.not_dvd_cyclotomicUnitIndex_of_bernoulli_nonzero
statement:
theorem not_dvd_cyclotomicUnitIndex_of_bernoulli_nonzero
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2)
    (hB : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → 2 * j ≤ p - 3 →
      ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (_root_.bernoulli (2 * j)).num) :
    ¬ p ∣ (CPlus (p := p) (K := K)
      (by have hp_two := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le; omega)).index
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp_three : 3 ≤ p := by
    have hp_two := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le
    omega
  by_cases hp_eq_three : p = 3
  · have hindex :
        (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).index = 1 := by
      rw [CPlus_eq_top_of_eq_three (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_eq_three]
      exact Subgroup.index_top
    rw [show
      (CPlus (p := p) (K := K)
        (by have hp_two := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le; omega)).index =
          (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).index by rfl]
    rw [hindex]
    intro hdiv
    exact (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).ne_one (Nat.dvd_one.mp hdiv)
  · have hp_five : 5 ≤ p := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).odd_of_ne_two hp_odd
      have hp_two := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le
      omega
    have hdet :
        (CyclotomicUnits.concreteKummerLogMatrix
          (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five).det ≠ 0 :=
      (CyclotomicUnits.kummerLogMatrix_det_ne_zero_iff_bernoulli_nonzero
        (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five).mpr hB
    have hsat :
        pSaturated (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three) (EPlus (K := K)) p :=
      CyclotomicUnits.cyclotomicUnits_pSaturated_of_kummerLog_det_ne_zero
        (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hp_five hdet
    have hnot := not_dvd_index_of_pSaturated (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hsat
    rwa [show
      (CPlus (p := p) (K := K)
        (by have hp_two := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le; omega)).index =
          (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).index by rfl]

name: KummerCriterion.not_dvd_hPlus_of_not_dvd_hMinus_units
statement:
theorem not_dvd_hPlus_of_not_dvd_hMinus_units
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hminus : ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ hMinus K) :
    ¬ (p : ℕ) ∣ hPlus K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp_three : 3 ≤ p := by
    have hp_two := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le
    omega
  have hB :
      ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → 2 * j ≤ p - 3 →
        ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (_root_.bernoulli (2 * j)).num :=
    bernoulli_nonzero_of_not_dvd_hMinus
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hminus
  have hindex :
      ¬ p ∣ (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).index := by
    simpa using
      not_dvd_cyclotomicUnitIndex_of_bernoulli_nonzero
        (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hB
  intro hplus
  have hnormalized :
      p ∣ (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).index :=
    (cyclotomicUnitIndex_primeConductor_pPrimary
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd).mpr hplus
  have hCPlus :
      p ∣ (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).index :=
    (CPlus_index_prime_dvd_iff_normalizedCPlus_index_prime_dvd
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).mpr hnormalized
  exact hindex hCPlus

name: KummerCriterion.weakReflection_dvd_hMinus_of_dvd_hPlus_units
statement:
theorem weakReflection_dvd_hMinus_of_dvd_hPlus_units
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hplus : (p : ℕ) ∣ hPlus K) :
    (p : ℕ) ∣ hMinus K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hminus
  exact not_dvd_hPlus_of_not_dvd_hMinus_units
    (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hminus hplus

name: KummerCriterion.dvd_h_iff_exists_dvd_bernoulli_units
statement:
theorem dvd_h_iff_exists_dvd_bernoulli_units
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) :
    (p : ℕ) ∣ h K ↔
      ∃ k, 1 ≤ k ∧ 2 * k ≤ p - 3 ∧ (p : ℤ) ∣ (bernoulli (2 * k)).num
proof:
:= by
  rw [dvd_h_iff_dvd_hMinus_of_dvd_hPlus_imp hp_odd
      (weakReflection_dvd_hMinus_of_dvd_hPlus_units (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd),
    p_dvd_hMinus_iff_p_dvd_some_bernoulli (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd]

name: KummerCriterion.prime_not_dvd_of_dvd_two_pow
statement:
theorem prime_not_dvd_of_dvd_two_pow {p n r : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hp_odd : p ≠ 2)
    (hn : n ∣ 2 ^ r) : ¬ p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  intro hpn
  have hp_dvd_two_pow : p ∣ 2 ^ r := hpn.trans hn
  have hp_dvd_two : p ∣ 2 := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hp_dvd_two_pow
  have hp_le_two : p ≤ 2 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) hp_dvd_two
  exact hp_odd (le_antisymm hp_le_two hp.two_le)

name: KummerCriterion.subgroup_index_prime_dvd_iff_of_not_dvd_relIndex
statement:
theorem subgroup_index_prime_dvd_iff_of_not_dvd_relIndex {G : Type*} [Group G]
    {H K : Subgroup G} (hHK : H ≤ K) {p : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p)
    (hrel : ¬ p ∣ H.relIndex K) :
    p ∣ H.index ↔ p ∣ K.index
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hH
    have hmul : p ∣ H.relIndex K * K.index := by
      rw [Subgroup.relIndex_mul_index hHK]
      exact hH
    rcases hp.dvd_mul.mp hmul with hp_rel | hp_K
    · exact (hrel hp_rel).elim
    · exact hp_K
  · intro hK
    rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_mul_index hHK]
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hK (H.relIndex K)

name: KummerCriterion.subgroup_index_prime_dvd_iff_of_relIndex_dvd_two_pow
statement:
theorem subgroup_index_prime_dvd_iff_of_relIndex_dvd_two_pow {G : Type*} [Group G]
    {H K : Subgroup G} (hHK : H ≤ K) {p r : ℕ} (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hp_odd : p ≠ 2)
    (hrel : H.relIndex K ∣ 2 ^ r) :
    p ∣ H.index ↔ p ∣ K.index
proof:
:=
  subgroup_index_prime_dvd_iff_of_not_dvd_relIndex hHK hp
    (prime_not_dvd_of_dvd_two_pow hp hp_odd hrel)

name: KummerCriterion.neg_one_mem_normalizedCPlus
statement:
theorem neg_one_mem_normalizedCPlus (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    (-1 : (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ) ∈ normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure (by left; rfl)

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCPlusGenerator_mem
statement:
theorem normalizedCPlusGenerator_mem (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p)
    (i : Fin ((p - 3) / 2)) :
    normalizedCPlusGenerator (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three i ∈
      normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure (by right; exact ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCPlusGenerator_sq_eq_CPlusGenerator
statement:
theorem normalizedCPlusGenerator_sq_eq_CPlusGenerator
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p)
    (i : Fin ((p - 3) / 2)) :
    normalizedCPlusGenerator (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three i ^ 2 =
      CPlusGenerator (p := p) (K := K) hp_three i
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedCPlusGenerator CPlusGenerator
  exact normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlusUnit_sq_eq_realCyclotomicUnit
    (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd
    (CPlusGeneratorIndex (p := p) hp_three i)
    (CPlusGeneratorIndex_two_le (p := p) hp_three i)
    (CPlusGeneratorIndex_le_half (p := p) hp_three i)

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCPlusGenerator_sq_mem_CPlus
statement:
theorem normalizedCPlusGenerator_sq_mem_CPlus
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p)
    (i : Fin ((p - 3) / 2)) :
    normalizedCPlusGenerator (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three i ^ 2 ∈
      CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedCPlusGenerator_sq_eq_CPlusGenerator
    (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three i]
  exact CPlusGenerator_mem (p := p) (K := K) hp_three i

name: KummerCriterion.CPlus_le_normalizedCPlus
statement:
theorem CPlus_le_normalizedCPlus (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three ≤
      normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three
proof:
:= by
  unfold CPlus
  rw [Subgroup.closure_le]
  rintro x (hx | hx)
  · rcases hx with rfl
    exact neg_one_mem_normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three
  · rcases hx with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [← normalizedCPlusGenerator_sq_eq_CPlusGenerator
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three i]
    exact Subgroup.pow_mem _
      (normalizedCPlusGenerator_mem (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three i) 2

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCPlus_sq_mem_CPlus
statement:
theorem normalizedCPlus_sq_mem_CPlus (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p)
    {x : (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ}
    (hx : x ∈ normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three) :
    x ^ 2 ∈ CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedCPlus at hx
  induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rcases hx with rfl
        simp
      · rcases hx with ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact normalizedCPlusGenerator_sq_mem_CPlus
          (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three i
  | one =>
      simp
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
      simpa [pow_two, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using
        (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).mul_mem hx hy
  | inv x _ hx =>
      simpa [pow_two] using
        (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).inv_mem hx

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCPlus_quotient_pow_two_eq_one
statement:
theorem normalizedCPlus_quotient_pow_two_eq_one (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p)
    (x :
      normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three ⧸
        (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).subgroupOf
          (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three)) :
    x ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' x ?_
  intro x
  rw [← QuotientGroup.mk_pow, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff]
  rw [Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf]
  simpa using
    normalizedCPlus_sq_mem_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three x.property

name: KummerCriterion.CPlus_relIndex_normalizedCPlus_dvd_two_pow
statement:
theorem CPlus_relIndex_normalizedCPlus_dvd_two_pow (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).relIndex
        (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three) ∣
      2 ^ Group.rank
        (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three ⧸
          (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).subgroupOf
            (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Subgroup.relIndex, Subgroup.index] using
    (card_dvd_exponent_pow_rank'
      (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three ⧸
        (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).subgroupOf
          (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three))
      (n := 2)
      (normalizedCPlus_quotient_pow_two_eq_one
        (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three))

name: KummerCriterion.CPlus_index_prime_dvd_iff_normalizedCPlus_index_prime_dvd
statement:
theorem CPlus_index_prime_dvd_iff_normalizedCPlus_index_prime_dvd
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    p ∣ (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).index ↔
      p ∣ (normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three).index
proof:
:=
  subgroup_index_prime_dvd_iff_of_relIndex_dvd_two_pow
    (CPlus_le_normalizedCPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three)
    (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p) hp_odd
    (CPlus_relIndex_normalizedCPlus_dvd_two_pow
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three)

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.kummerLogColumnIndex_two_le
statement:
theorem kummerLogColumnIndex_two_le
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (a : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) :
    2 ≤ kummerLogColumnIndex (p := p) hp_three a
proof:
:=
  CPlusGeneratorIndex_two_le (p := p) hp_three a

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.kummerLogColumnIndex_le_half
statement:
theorem kummerLogColumnIndex_le_half
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (a : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) :
    kummerLogColumnIndex (p := p) hp_three a ≤ (p - 1) / 2
proof:
:=
  CPlusGeneratorIndex_le_half (p := p) hp_three a

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.kummerLogColumnIndex_lt_p
statement:
theorem kummerLogColumnIndex_lt_p
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (a : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) :
    kummerLogColumnIndex (p := p) hp_three a < p
proof:
:= by
  have hle := kummerLogColumnIndex_le_half (p := p) hp_three a
  have hhalf : (p - 1) / 2 < p := by omega
  omega

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.zmod_natCast_eq_of_lt
statement:
theorem zmod_natCast_eq_of_lt {a b p : ℕ} (ha : a < p) (hb : b < p)
    (h : (a : ZMod p) = (b : ZMod p)) :
    a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff', Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb] at h
  exact h

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.zmod_natCast_ne_zero_of_pos_lt
statement:
theorem zmod_natCast_ne_zero_of_pos_lt {a p : ℕ} (ha_pos : 0 < a) (ha_lt : a < p) :
    (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at hzero
  exact (not_le_of_gt ha_lt) (Nat.le_of_dvd ha_pos hzero)

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.kummerLogColumnIndex_add_ne_zero
statement:
theorem kummerLogColumnIndex_add_ne_zero
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (a b : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) :
    ((kummerLogColumnIndex (p := p) hp_three a +
        kummerLogColumnIndex (p := p) hp_three b : ℕ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine zmod_natCast_ne_zero_of_pos_lt ?_ ?_
  · have ha_two := kummerLogColumnIndex_two_le (p := p) hp_three a
    omega
  · have ha := kummerLogColumnIndex_le_half (p := p) hp_three a
    have hb := kummerLogColumnIndex_le_half (p := p) hp_three b
    have hdouble : 2 * ((p - 1) / 2) ≤ p - 1 := by
      simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using Nat.div_mul_le_self (p - 1) 2
    omega

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.teichmullerEvenNode_injective
statement:
theorem teichmullerEvenNode_injective (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    Function.Injective (teichmullerEvenNode (p := p) hp_three)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hsq
  dsimp [teichmullerEvenNode] at hsq
  let A : ℕ := kummerLogColumnIndex (p := p) hp_three a
  let B : ℕ := kummerLogColumnIndex (p := p) hp_three b
  have hfactor : ((A : ZMod p) - (B : ZMod p)) * ((A : ZMod p) + (B : ZMod p)) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((A : ZMod p) - (B : ZMod p)) * ((A : ZMod p) + (B : ZMod p)) =
          (A : ZMod p) ^ 2 - (B : ZMod p) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 0 := by
        simpa [A, B] using sub_eq_zero.mpr hsq
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with hsub | hadd
  · have hAB_zmod : (A : ZMod p) = (B : ZMod p) := sub_eq_zero.mp hsub
    have hAB : A = B :=
      zmod_natCast_eq_of_lt
        (kummerLogColumnIndex_lt_p (p := p) hp_three a)
        (kummerLogColumnIndex_lt_p (p := p) hp_three b)
        hAB_zmod
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp [A, B, kummerLogColumnIndex, CPlusGeneratorIndex] at hAB
    omega
  · have hadd_nat :
        ((A + B : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      simpa [A, B, Nat.cast_add] using hadd
    exfalso
    exact (kummerLogColumnIndex_add_ne_zero (p := p) hp_three a b) hadd_nat

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.teichmullerEvenNode_ne_one
statement:
theorem teichmullerEvenNode_ne_one (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (a : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) :
    teichmullerEvenNode (p := p) hp_three a ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  dsimp [teichmullerEvenNode] at h
  let A : ℕ := kummerLogColumnIndex (p := p) hp_three a
  have hfactor : ((A : ZMod p) - 1) * ((A : ZMod p) + 1) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((A : ZMod p) - 1) * ((A : ZMod p) + 1) =
          (A : ZMod p) ^ 2 - 1 := by ring
      _ = 0 := by
        simpa [A] using sub_eq_zero.mpr h
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with hsub | hadd
  · have hA1_zmod : (A : ZMod p) = 1 := by simpa using sub_eq_zero.mp hsub
    have hA1 : A = 1 :=
      zmod_natCast_eq_of_lt
        (kummerLogColumnIndex_lt_p (p := p) hp_three a)
        (by omega)
        (by simpa using hA1_zmod)
    have hA_two := kummerLogColumnIndex_two_le (p := p) hp_three a
    omega
  · have hAp1 :
        ((A + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      simpa [A, Nat.cast_add] using hadd
    exact zmod_natCast_ne_zero_of_pos_lt
      (a := A + 1) (p := p)
      (by omega)
      (by
        have hA := kummerLogColumnIndex_le_half (p := p) hp_three a
        have hhalf : (p - 1) / 2 + 1 < p := by omega
        omega)
      hAp1

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.geomPolynomial_natDegree
statement:
theorem geomPolynomial_natDegree (j : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) :
    (geomPolynomial (p := p) j).natDegree = (j : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold geomPolynomial
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero
  · refine Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
      (s := Finset.range ((j : ℕ) + 1))
      (n := (j : ℕ))
      (fun i => (X : (ZMod p)[X]) ^ i) ?_
    intro i hi
    exact (Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_le i).trans (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
  · simp

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.geomPolynomial_monic
statement:
theorem geomPolynomial_monic (j : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) :
    (geomPolynomial (p := p) j).Monic
proof:
:= by
  unfold geomPolynomial
  exact Polynomial.monic_geom_sum_X (R := ZMod p) (by omega)

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.geomPolynomial_eval
statement:
theorem geomPolynomial_eval (hp_three : 3 ≤ p)
    (a j : Fin (kummerLogRank p)) :
    (geomPolynomial (p := p) j).eval (teichmullerEvenNode (p := p) hp_three a) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range ((j : ℕ) + 1),
        teichmullerEvenNode (p := p) hp_three a ^ i
proof:
:= by
  simp [geomPolynomial]

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.det_geomEvaluationMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_geomEvaluationMatrix_ne_zero (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    (geomEvaluationMatrix (p := p) hp_three).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdet :=
    Matrix.det_eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_det_vandermonde
      (R := ZMod p)
      (v := teichmullerEvenNode (p := p) hp_three)
      (p := geomPolynomial (p := p))
      (h_deg := geomPolynomial_natDegree (p := p))
      (h_monic := geomPolynomial_monic (p := p))
  have hvand_ne :
      (Matrix.vandermonde (teichmullerEvenNode (p := p) hp_three)).det ≠ 0 :=
    Matrix.det_vandermonde_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      (teichmullerEvenNode_injective (p := p) hp_three)
  simpa [geomEvaluationMatrix] using hdet ▸ hvand_ne

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.transpose_vandermondeTeichmullerEvenSubOneMatrix_eq_diagonal_mul_geomEvaluationMatrix
statement:
theorem transpose_vandermondeTeichmullerEvenSubOneMatrix_eq_diagonal_mul_geomEvaluationMatrix
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    (vandermondeTeichmullerEvenSubOneMatrix (p := p) hp_three)ᵀ =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun a : Fin (kummerLogRank p) =>
        teichmullerEvenNode (p := p) hp_three a - 1) *
        geomEvaluationMatrix (p := p) hp_three
proof:
:= by
  ext a j
  simp [vandermondeTeichmullerEvenSubOneMatrix, geomEvaluationMatrix,
    geomPolynomial_eval, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
    (geom_sum_mul (teichmullerEvenNode (p := p) hp_three a) ((j : ℕ) + 1)).symm

name: KummerCriterion.CyclotomicUnits.vandermonde_teichmuller_even_sub_one_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem vandermonde_teichmuller_even_sub_one_det_ne_zero
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    (vandermondeTeichmullerEvenSubOneMatrix (p := p) hp_three).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have htranspose :=
    congrArg Matrix.det
      (transpose_vandermondeTeichmullerEvenSubOneMatrix_eq_diagonal_mul_geomEvaluationMatrix
        (p := p) hp_three)
  rw [Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal] at htranspose
  rw [htranspose]
  exact mul_ne_zero
    (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      (by
        intro a _
        exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (teichmullerEvenNode_ne_one (p := p) hp_three a)))
    (det_geomEvaluationMatrix_ne_zero (p := p) hp_three)

name: KummerCriterion.realCyclotomicUnit_index_coprime
statement:
theorem realCyclotomicUnit_index_coprime {a : ℕ}
    (ha_two : 2 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ (p - 1) / 2) : a.Coprime p
proof:
:= by
  have hp_prime : Nat.Prime p := Fact.out
  have ha_pos : 0 < a := by omega
  have ha_lt : a < p := by
    have hhalf : (p - 1) / 2 < p := by omega
    omega
  have hnot : ¬ p ∣ a := fun hpa => by
    exact (not_le_of_gt ha_lt) (Nat.le_of_dvd ha_pos hpa)
  exact (hp_prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hnot).symm

name: KummerCriterion.realCyclotomicUnit_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realCyclotomicUnit_val (a : ℕ)
    (ha_two : 2 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ (p - 1) / 2) :
    (realCyclotomicUnit (p := p) (K := K) a ha_two ha_le : 𝓞 K⁺) =
      LehmerVandiver.realCyclotomicUnitPlus p K a
proof:
:= by
  unfold realCyclotomicUnit
  rw [LehmerVandiver.realCyclotomicUnitPlusUnit_val]

name: KummerCriterion.algebraMap_realCyclotomicUnit
statement:
theorem algebraMap_realCyclotomicUnit (a : ℕ)
    (ha_two : 2 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ (p - 1) / 2) :
    algebraMap (𝓞 K⁺) (𝓞 K)
        (realCyclotomicUnit (p := p) (K := K) a ha_two ha_le : 𝓞 K⁺) =
      LehmerVandiver.realCyclotomicUnit p K a
proof:
:= by
  rw [realCyclotomicUnit_val, LehmerVandiver.algebraMap_realCyclotomicUnitPlus]

name: KummerCriterion.CPlusGeneratorIndex_two_le
statement:
theorem CPlusGeneratorIndex_two_le (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (i : Fin ((p - 3) / 2)) :
    2 ≤ CPlusGeneratorIndex (p := p) hp_three i
proof:
:= by
  simp [CPlusGeneratorIndex]

name: KummerCriterion.CPlusGeneratorIndex_le_half
statement:
theorem CPlusGeneratorIndex_le_half (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (i : Fin ((p - 3) / 2)) :
    CPlusGeneratorIndex (p := p) hp_three i ≤ (p - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (i : ℕ) < (p - 3) / 2 := i.isLt
  have hp_odd_mod : p % 2 = 1 :=
    Nat.odd_iff.mp ((Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).odd_of_ne_two (by omega))
  have hhalf : (p - 1) / 2 = (p - 3) / 2 + 1 := by
    omega
  dsimp [CPlusGeneratorIndex]
  rw [hhalf]
  omega

name: KummerCriterion.neg_one_mem_CPlus
statement:
theorem neg_one_mem_CPlus (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    (-1 : (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ) ∈ CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure (by left; rfl)

name: KummerCriterion.CPlusGenerator_mem
statement:
theorem CPlusGenerator_mem (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (i : Fin ((p - 3) / 2)) :
    CPlusGenerator (p := p) (K := K) hp_three i ∈ CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three
proof:
:=
  Subgroup.subset_closure (by right; exact ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: KummerCriterion.pSaturated.mem_pPowerSubgroup_of_mem
statement:
theorem pSaturated.mem_pPowerSubgroup_of_mem {G : Type*} [CommGroup G]
    {H E : Subgroup G} {p : ℕ} (h : pSaturated H E p) {x : G}
    (hxH : x ∈ H) (hxEpow : x ∈ pPowerSubgroup E p) :
    x ∈ pPowerSubgroup H p
proof:
:=
  h.2 ⟨hxH, hxEpow⟩

name: KummerCriterion.CPlus_le_EPlus
statement:
theorem CPlus_le_EPlus (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) :
    CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three ≤ EPlus (K := K)
proof:
:= by
  simp [EPlus]

name: KummerCriterion.CPlusExponentProduct_mul
statement:
theorem CPlusExponentProduct_mul (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (s t : ℤ)
    (e f : Fin ((p - 3) / 2) → ℤ) :
    CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s e *
        CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three t f =
      CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three (s + t) (e + f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [CPlusExponentProduct, zpow_add, Finset.prod_mul_distrib, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]

name: KummerCriterion.CPlusExponentProduct_inv
statement:
theorem CPlusExponentProduct_inv (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (s : ℤ)
    (e : Fin ((p - 3) / 2) → ℤ) :
    (CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s e)⁻¹ =
      CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three (-s) (-e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [CPlusExponentProduct, Finset.prod_inv_distrib, mul_comm]

name: KummerCriterion.CPlusExponentProduct_single
statement:
theorem CPlusExponentProduct_single (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (i : Fin ((p - 3) / 2)) :
    CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three 0
        (fun j => if j = i then 1 else 0) =
      CPlusGenerator (p := p) (K := K) hp_three i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold CPlusExponentProduct
  simp only [zpow_zero, one_mul]
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hj
    simp [hj]
  · intro hi
    exact False.elim (hi (Finset.mem_univ i))

name: KummerCriterion.CPlusExponentProduct_mem_CPlus
statement:
theorem CPlusExponentProduct_mem_CPlus (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (s : ℤ)
    (e : Fin ((p - 3) / 2) → ℤ) :
    CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s e ∈
      CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold CPlusExponentProduct
  exact (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).mul_mem
    ((CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).zpow_mem
      (neg_one_mem_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three) s)
    ((CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).prod_mem fun a _ =>
      (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three).zpow_mem
        (CPlusGenerator_mem (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a) (e a))

name: KummerCriterion.exists_CPlusExponentProduct_of_mem_CPlus
statement:
theorem exists_CPlusExponentProduct_of_mem_CPlus (hp_three : 3 ≤ p)
    {x : (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ} (hx : x ∈ CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three) :
    ∃ (s : ℤ) (e : Fin ((p - 3) / 2) → ℤ),
      CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s e = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold CPlus at hx
  induction hx using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rcases hx with rfl
        refine ⟨1, 0, ?_⟩
        simp [CPlusExponentProduct]
      · rcases hx with ⟨i, rfl⟩
        refine ⟨0, (fun j => if j = i then 1 else 0), ?_⟩
        exact CPlusExponentProduct_single (p := p) (K := K) hp_three i
  | one =>
      refine ⟨0, 0, ?_⟩
      simp [CPlusExponentProduct]
  | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
      rcases hx with ⟨s, e, hx⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨t, f, hy⟩
      refine ⟨s + t, e + f, ?_⟩
      rw [← hx, ← hy, CPlusExponentProduct_mul]
  | inv x _ hx =>
      rcases hx with ⟨s, e, hx⟩
      refine ⟨-s, -e, ?_⟩
      rw [← hx, ← CPlusExponentProduct_inv]

name: KummerCriterion.zpow_pow_eq_self_of_sq_eq_one_of_odd
proof:
:= by
  have hn_split : n = 2 * (n / 2) + 1 := by omega
  have hxs_sq : (x ^ s) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    calc
      (x ^ s) ^ 2 = (x ^ s) ^ (2 : ℤ) :=
        (zpow_natCast (x ^ s) 2).symm
      _ = x ^ (s * (2 : ℤ)) := by rw [zpow_mul]
      _ = x ^ ((2 : ℤ) * s) := by rw [mul_comm]
      _ = (x ^ (2 : ℤ)) ^ s := by rw [zpow_mul]
      _ = (x ^ 2) ^ s :=
        congrArg (fun y : G => y ^ s) (zpow_natCast x 2)
      _ = 1 := by rw [hx_sq, one_zpow]
  calc
    (x ^ s) ^ n = (x ^ s) ^ (2 * (n / 2) + 1) :=
      congrArg (fun m : ℕ => (x ^ s) ^ m) hn_split
    _ = (x ^ s) ^ (2 * (n / 2)) * x ^ s := by rw [pow_add, pow_one]
    _ = ((x ^ s) ^ 2) ^ (n / 2) * x ^ s := by rw [pow_mul]
    _ = x ^ s := by rw [hxs_sq]; simp

name: KummerCriterion.neg_one_zpow_pow_eq_self
statement:
theorem neg_one_zpow_pow_eq_self (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (s : ℤ) :
    ((-1 : (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ) ^ s) ^ p = (-1 : (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ) ^ s
proof:
:= by
  have hp_mod : p % 2 = 1 :=
    Nat.odd_iff.mp ((Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).odd_of_ne_two hp_odd)
  have hneg_sq : ((-1 : (𝓞 K⁺)ˣ) ^ 2) = 1 := by
    ext
    simp
  exact zpow_pow_eq_self_of_sq_eq_one_of_odd hneg_sq hp_mod s

name: KummerCriterion.CPlusExponentProduct_pow_of_exponents_eq_mul
statement:
theorem CPlusExponentProduct_pow_of_exponents_eq_mul (hp_odd : p ≠ 2)
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p) (s : ℤ) (e k : Fin ((p - 3) / 2) → ℤ)
    (hk : ∀ a, e a = (p : ℤ) * k a) :
    CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s k ^ p =
      CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold CPlusExponentProduct
  rw [mul_pow, neg_one_zpow_pow_eq_self (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd s,
    ← Finset.prod_pow]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl ?_
  intro a _
  calc
    (CPlusGenerator (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a ^ k a) ^ p =
        CPlusGenerator (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a ^ (k a * (p : ℤ)) := by
          rw [← zpow_natCast, zpow_mul]
    _ = CPlusGenerator (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a ^ ((p : ℤ) * k a) := by
          rw [mul_comm]
    _ = CPlusGenerator (p := p) (K := K) hp_three a ^ e a := by
          rw [hk a]

name: KummerCriterion.CPlus_pSaturated_of_generator_exponents_modP_zero
statement:
theorem CPlus_pSaturated_of_generator_exponents_modP_zero (hp_odd : p ≠ 2)
    (hp_three : 3 ≤ p)
    (h : ∀ (s : ℤ) (e : Fin ((p - 3) / 2) → ℤ),
      CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s e ∈
          pPowerSubgroup (EPlus (K := K)) p →
        ∀ a, (e a : ZMod p) = 0) :
    pSaturated (CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three) (EPlus (K := K)) p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨CPlus_le_EPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨hxC, hxEpow⟩
  rcases exists_CPlusExponentProduct_of_mem_CPlus
      (p := p) (K := K) hp_three hxC with
    ⟨s, e, hxe⟩
  have hzero : ∀ a, (e a : ZMod p) = 0 := by
    refine h s e ?_
    simpa [hxe] using hxEpow
  have hdiv : ∀ a, (p : ℤ) ∣ e a := fun a =>
    (CharP.intCast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod p) p (e a)).mp (hzero a)
  choose k hk using hdiv
  refine ⟨CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s k,
    CPlusExponentProduct_mem_CPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s k, ?_⟩
  calc
    CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s k ^ p =
        CPlusExponentProduct (p := p) (K := K) hp_three s e :=
          CPlusExponentProduct_pow_of_exponents_eq_mul
            (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd hp_three s e k hk
    _ = x := hxe

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCyclotomicUnitExponent_spec
statement:
theorem normalizedCyclotomicUnitExponent_spec (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (a : ℕ) :
    ((2 * normalizedCyclotomicUnitExponent p a : ℕ) : ZMod p) =
      1 - (a : ZMod p)
proof:
:= by
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime 2 p := by
    simpa using ((Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).odd_of_ne_two hp_odd).coprime_two_left
  have hunit : IsUnit (2 : ZMod p) := (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime 2 p).2 hcop
  unfold normalizedCyclotomicUnitExponent
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
  change (2 : ZMod p) * ((2 : ZMod p)⁻¹ * (1 - (a : ZMod p))) = 1 - (a : ZMod p)
  rw [← mul_assoc, ZMod.mul_inv_of_unit (2 : ZMod p) hunit, one_mul]

name: KummerCriterion.zetaUnit_pow_eq_of_zmod_eq
proof:
:= by
  let ζu : (𝓞 K)ˣ := (zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit'
  change ζu ^ m = ζu ^ n
  have hord : orderOf ζu = p := by
    rw [← orderOf_units]
    exact ((IsPrimitiveRoot.unit'_coe (zeta_spec p ℚ K)).eq_orderOf).symm
  rw [pow_inj_mod, hord]
  exact (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff m n p).mp h

name: KummerCriterion.zeta_pow_eq_of_zmod_eq
statement:
theorem zeta_pow_eq_of_zmod_eq {m n : ℕ}
    (h : (m : ZMod p) = (n : ZMod p)) :
    ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K) ^ m =
      ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K) ^ n
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun u : (𝓞 K)ˣ => (u : 𝓞 K))
    (zetaUnit_pow_eq_of_zmod_eq (p := p) (K := K) h)

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent_val (a e : ℕ)
    (ha : a.Coprime p) (hp_two : 2 ≤ p) :
    (normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent (p := p) (K := K) a e ha hp_two : 𝓞 K) =
      ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K) ^ e * LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit p K a
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent, LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnitUnit_val]

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCyclotomicUnitK_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedCyclotomicUnitK_val (a : ℕ)
    (ha : a.Coprime p) :
    (normalizedCyclotomicUnitK (p := p) (K := K) a ha : 𝓞 K) =
      ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K) ^
          normalizedCyclotomicUnitExponent p a * LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit p K a
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalizedCyclotomicUnitK]

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent_sq_val
statement:
theorem normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent_sq_val (a e : ℕ)
    (ha : a.Coprime p) (hp_two : 2 ≤ p) :
    (normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent (p := p) (K := K) a e ha hp_two ^ 2 : 𝓞 K) =
      ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K) ^ (2 * e) *
        (LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit p K a) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let ζ : 𝓞 K := ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K)
  let c : 𝓞 K := LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit p K a
  change (ζ ^ e * c) ^ 2 = ζ ^ (2 * e) * c ^ 2
  rw [pow_two, pow_two]
  calc
    (ζ ^ e * c) * (ζ ^ e * c) = (ζ ^ e * ζ ^ e) * (c * c) := by ring
    _ = ζ ^ (e + e) * (c * c) := by rw [← pow_add]
    _ = ζ ^ (2 * e) * (c * c) := by rw [two_mul]

name: KummerCriterion.ringOfIntegersComplexConj_cyclotomicUnit_eq_zeta_pow_mul_self
statement:
theorem ringOfIntegersComplexConj_cyclotomicUnit_eq_zeta_pow_mul_self
    (a : ℕ) (_ha_pos : 1 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ p) :
    ringOfIntegersComplexConj K (LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit p K a) =
      ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K) ^ (p + 1 - a) *
        LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit p K a
proof:
:= by
  let ζ : 𝓞 K := ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K)
  let c : ℕ → 𝓞 K := LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit p K
  have hζp : ζ ^ p = 1 :=
    (zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit'_coe.pow_eq_one
  have hσ := LehmerVandiver.Sinnott.cyclotomicUnit_pred_mul_complexConj_cyclotomicUnit_eq
    (p := p) (K := K) a ha_le
  change c (p - 1) * ringOfIntegersComplexConj K (c a) = c (p - a) at hσ
  have hpred : c (p - 1) = -ζ ^ (p - 1) := by
    simpa [c, ζ] using LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit_p_sub_one (p := p) (K := K)
  rw [hpred] at hσ
  have hσ' : ζ ^ (p - 1) * ringOfIntegersComplexConj K (c a) = -c (p - a) := by
    linear_combination -hσ
  have hconj : ringOfIntegersComplexConj K (c a) = -ζ * c (p - a) := by
    calc
      ringOfIntegersComplexConj K (c a)
          = ζ ^ p * ringOfIntegersComplexConj K (c a) := by rw [hζp, one_mul]
      _ = ζ * (ζ ^ (p - 1) * ringOfIntegersComplexConj K (c a)) := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm ζ (ζ ^ (p - 1)), ← pow_succ,
          Nat.sub_one_add_one (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).ne_zero]
      _ = -ζ * c (p - a) := by rw [hσ']; ring
  have hpair : c a = -ζ ^ a * c (p - a) := by
    simpa [c, ζ] using
      LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit_eq_neg_zeta_pow_mul_cyclotomicUnit_p_sub
        (p := p) (K := K) a ha_le
  rw [hconj]
  change -ζ * c (p - a) = ζ ^ (p + 1 - a) * c a
  rw [hpair]
  have ha_le_succ : a ≤ p + 1 := le_trans ha_le (Nat.le_succ p)
  calc
    -ζ * c (p - a)
        = ζ ^ (p + 1 - a) * (-ζ ^ a * c (p - a)) := by
          rw [show ζ ^ (p + 1 - a) * (-ζ ^ a * c (p - a)) =
              -(ζ ^ (p + 1 - a) * ζ ^ a) * c (p - a) by ring,
            ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel ha_le_succ]
          rw [show p + 1 = p.succ by rfl, pow_succ, hζp]
          ring
    _ = ζ ^ (p + 1 - a) * (-ζ ^ a * c (p - a)) := rfl

name: KummerCriterion.unitsComplexConj_normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent
statement:
theorem unitsComplexConj_normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent
    (a e : ℕ) (ha : a.Coprime p) (ha_pos : 1 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ p)
    (hp_two : 2 ≤ p)
    (he : ((2 * e : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 1 - (a : ZMod p)) :
    unitsComplexConj K
        (normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent (p := p) (K := K) a e ha hp_two) =
      normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent (p := p) (K := K) a e ha hp_two
proof:
:= by
  let ζ : 𝓞 K := ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K)
  let c : 𝓞 K := LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit p K a
  apply Units.ext
  change ringOfIntegersComplexConj K
      (ζ ^ e * c) = ζ ^ e * c
  rw [map_mul, map_pow]
  have hconjζ : ringOfIntegersComplexConj K ζ = ζ ^ (p - 1) := by
    change ringOfIntegersComplexConj K ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K) =
      ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K) ^ (p - 1)
    change ringOfIntegersComplexConj K (zeta_spec p ℚ K).toInteger =
      (zeta_spec p ℚ K).toInteger ^ (p - 1)
    exact complexConj_apply_zeta (p := p) (K := K)
  rw [hconjζ]
  have hc : ringOfIntegersComplexConj K c = ζ ^ (p + 1 - a) * c := by
    simpa [c, ζ] using
      ringOfIntegersComplexConj_cyclotomicUnit_eq_zeta_pow_mul_self
        (p := p) (K := K) a ha_pos ha_le
  rw [hc]
  have ha_le_succ : a ≤ p + 1 := le_trans ha_le (Nat.le_succ p)
  have hp_one : 1 ≤ p := (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).one_le
  have hpred : ((p - 1 : ℕ) : ZMod p) = -1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hp_one, Nat.cast_one]
    simp
  have hsub : ((p + 1 - a : ℕ) : ZMod p) = 1 - (a : ZMod p) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub ha_le_succ, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    simp
  have hmod :
      (((p - 1) * e + (p + 1 - a) : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (e : ZMod p) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, hpred, hsub, ← he]
    rw [Nat.cast_mul]
    ring
  have hpow : ζ ^ ((p - 1) * e + (p + 1 - a)) = ζ ^ e := by
    simpa [ζ] using zeta_pow_eq_of_zmod_eq (p := p) (K := K) hmod
  calc
    (ζ ^ (p - 1)) ^ e * (ζ ^ (p + 1 - a) * c)
        = ζ ^ ((p - 1) * e + (p + 1 - a)) * c := by
          rw [← pow_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add]
    _ = ζ ^ e * c := by rw [hpow]

name: KummerCriterion.unitsComplexConj_normalizedCyclotomicUnitK
statement:
theorem unitsComplexConj_normalizedCyclotomicUnitK
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (a : ℕ) (ha : a.Coprime p) (ha_pos : 1 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ p) :
    unitsComplexConj K (normalizedCyclotomicUnitK (p := p) (K := K) a ha) =
      normalizedCyclotomicUnitK (p := p) (K := K) a ha
proof:
:=
  unitsComplexConj_normalizedCyclotomicUnitKWithExponent
    (p := p) (K := K) a (normalizedCyclotomicUnitExponent p a) ha ha_pos ha_le
    (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p).two_le
    (normalizedCyclotomicUnitExponent_spec (p := p) hp_odd a)

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange_val (a : ℕ)
    (ha_two : 2 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ (p - 1) / 2) :
    (normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange (p := p) (K := K) a ha_two ha_le : 𝓞 K) =
      ((zeta_spec p ℚ K).unit' : 𝓞 K) ^
          normalizedCyclotomicUnitExponent p a * LehmerVandiver.cyclotomicUnit p K a
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange]

name: KummerCriterion.unitsComplexConj_normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange
statement:
theorem unitsComplexConj_normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (a : ℕ)
    (ha_two : 2 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ (p - 1) / 2) :
    unitsComplexConj K
        (normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange (p := p) (K := K) a ha_two ha_le) =
      normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange (p := p) (K := K) a ha_two ha_le
proof:
:= by
  apply unitsComplexConj_normalizedCyclotomicUnitK (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd
  · omega
  · have hhalf : (p - 1) / 2 ≤ p := by omega
    omega

name: KummerCriterion.exists_normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus
statement:
theorem exists_normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (a : ℕ)
    (ha_two : 2 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ (p - 1) / 2) :
    ∃ y : 𝓞 K⁺,
      algebraMap (𝓞 K⁺) (𝓞 K) y =
        (normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange (p := p) (K := K) a ha_two ha_le : 𝓞 K)
proof:
:= by
  let u : (𝓞 K)ˣ := normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange (p := p) (K := K) a ha_two ha_le
  have hunit := unitsComplexConj_normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange
    (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd a ha_two ha_le
  have hfixed : ringOfIntegersComplexConj K (u : 𝓞 K) = (u : 𝓞 K) := by
    have hval := congrArg (fun v : (𝓞 K)ˣ => (v : 𝓞 K)) hunit
    change ringOfIntegersComplexConj K (u : 𝓞 K) = (u : 𝓞 K) at hval
    exact hval
  exact (ringOfIntegersComplexConj_eq_self_iff K (u : 𝓞 K)).mp hfixed

name: KummerCriterion.algebraMap_normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (a : ℕ)
    (ha_two : 2 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ (p - 1) / 2) :
    algebraMap (𝓞 K⁺) (𝓞 K)
        (normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd a ha_two ha_le) =
      (normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange (p := p) (K := K) a ha_two ha_le : 𝓞 K)
proof:
:=
  (exists_normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd a ha_two ha_le).choose_spec

name: KummerCriterion.isUnit_normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus
statement:
theorem isUnit_normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (a : ℕ)
    (ha_two : 2 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ (p - 1) / 2) :
    IsUnit (normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd a ha_two ha_le)
proof:
:= by
  have h_unit : IsUnit (algebraMap (𝓞 K⁺) (𝓞 K)
      (normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd a ha_two ha_le)) := by
    rw [algebraMap_normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus]
    exact (normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange (p := p) (K := K) a ha_two ha_le).isUnit
  have h_norm_unit : IsUnit (RingOfIntegers.norm K⁺
      (algebraMap (𝓞 K⁺) (𝓞 K)
        (normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd a ha_two ha_le))) :=
    h_unit.map _
  rw [RingOfIntegers.norm_algebraMap] at h_norm_unit
  have hfin_ne : Module.finrank K⁺ K ≠ 0 := by
    rw [finrank_K_over_Kplus]
    decide
  exact (isUnit_pow_iff hfin_ne).mp h_norm_unit

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlusUnit_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlusUnit_val
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (a : ℕ)

    (normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlusUnit (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd a ha_two ha_le : 𝓞 K⁺) =
      normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlus (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd a ha_two ha_le

name: KummerCriterion.algebraMap_normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlusUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlusUnit
    (hp_odd : p ≠ 2) (a : ℕ)
    (ha_two : 2 ≤ a) (ha_le : a ≤ (p - 1) / 2) :
    algebraMap (𝓞 K⁺) (𝓞 K)
        (normalizedCyclotomicUnitPlusUnit (p := p) (K := K) hp_odd a ha_two ha_le) =
      (normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange (p := p) (K := K) a ha_two ha_le : 𝓞 K)

name: KummerCriterion.normalizedCyclotomicUnitKOfRange_sq_val_eq_realCyclotomicUnit
